learn: Add Part writes the master only. Period Next (03-Nov) gives a row of the next period only; Current after day D (27-Nov) gives the row of the next period too. A Candidate part has no staging row.
Candidate → Active, by Procurement (10-Nov) or by XD05 (27-Dec, DUMMY-006), is a Kanban ADD with OPERATION_TYPE 4; its destinations bring GTOPAS ADD rows.
The parent flow follows the GTOPAS rows of the run: scenario 1 on 10-Nov and 04-Dec (GTOPAS first), scenario 2 on 05-Nov, 27-Nov and 27-Dec (AP POLE only), rollovers XD06 only.
When GTOPAS fails (04-Dec 10:00), AP POLE gets nothing. The re-send sends the same run; a GTOPAS row done before counts as OK.
Every upload to AP POLE passes the check: EXPORT_PRE handles a Max going down (10-Nov, 27-Nov), ROW_ORDER handles a move inside a file (05-Nov, 27-Nov: TAIWAN before THAILAND would give 28 > 20).
OPERATION_TYPE is set at the save against the last value AP POLE has: the same period, else the previous period. Header 5 marks a part whose Kanban did not change and is never uploaded.
A value set back to the sent value sends nothing (03-Dec 09:30); an order type change is DELETE + ADD in AP POLE and nothing in GTOPAS (03-Dec 10:00).
An Inactive part keeps its Kanban row in AP POLE; its destinations get DELETE (0) once, in the first period it is Inactive.
